name: niwaterm
description: Terminal, multiplexer, and workspace integrated desktop app

scripts.build:vendor:win: cd vendor/libghostty && mise exec zig@0.16.0 -- zig build -Demit-lib-vt -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu -Doptimize=ReleaseFast --prefix "$PWD"
scripts.build:native:win: mise exec zig@0.16.0 -- zig cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu -shared -Ivendor/libghostty/include src/native/shim.c -Lvendor/libghostty/lib -lghostty-vt -o vendor/libghostty/bin/niwashim.dll
